claim: The reasons for resistance against conventional therapy and regrowth of untreatable tumor are attributed to the existence of cancer stem cells, which occupy only a small part of the entire cancer tissue.

evidence.quote: In fact, accumulating evidence indicates that conventional therapies often fail to eradicate carcinoma cells that have entered the CSC state via activation of the EMT programme, thereby permitting CSC-mediated clinical relapse.
evidence.note: Conventional therapies often fail to eradicate CSC-state cells, permitting CSC-mediated relapse. Strict re-read: the quote does not state Cancer stem cells occupying a small part of tissue not stated; quote concerns EMT-state CSCs and relapse.

evidence.quote: The introduction of the cancer stem cell (CSC) concept, which posits the presence of minor subpopulations of CSCs that are uniquely capable of seeding new tumours, has provided a framework for understanding one dimension of intratumoural heterogeneity.
evidence.note: Describes CSCs as minor subpopulations able to seed new tumours. Strict re-read: the quote does not state Resistance and regrowth attributed to CSCs, and CSCs being a small fraction, not stated.

claim: The Wnt/β-catenin pathway is activated through acetylcholine muscarinic receptor 3 and Notch3 signaling.

evidence.quote: M3 muscarinic receptors (M3R) modulate β-catenin signaling and colon neoplasia.
evidence.note: M3R modulates beta-catenin signaling in colon cancer; Notch3 not addressed.

evidence.quote: Inhibition of M3R signaling greatly suppressed DCA/LCA induction of the CSC marker ALDHA1 and also c-Myc mRNA expression as well as transcriptional activation of TCF/LEF.
evidence.note: M3R signaling drives TCF/LEF (Wnt/beta-catenin) activation in colonic cells; Notch3 not addressed.

claim: Trastuzumab treatment of breast cancer cells enriches CSCs with elevated IL-6 levels, and these cells develop resistance mediated by activation of an IL-6-mediated inflammatory feedback loop that expands the CSC population.

evidence.quote: Continued use of trastuzumab in HER2(+) PTEN(-) cells increased the frequency of cancer stem cells (CSCs) and metastasis potential.
evidence.note: Trastuzumab increases CSC frequency (HER2+ PTEN- cells); no statement of elevated IL-6 in the CSCs.

evidence.quote: Transformed resistant cells were sensitive to chemical probe (sulforaphane) through inhibition of IL-6/STAT3/NF-κB positive feedback loop whereas parental HER2(+) cells did not respond.
evidence.note: Mentions an IL-6/STAT3/NF-κB positive feedback loop in trastuzumab-resistant cells, not CSC expansion by it.

claim: Tumor-associated macrophages induce drug resistance in non-small cell lung cancer through secretion of multiple factors, such as TGF-β and TNF-α, which are potent epithelial-mesenchymal transition stimulators.

evidence.quote: TAMs promote tumor invasion, growth, and metastasis by promoting angiogenesis and EMT.
evidence.note: TAMs promote EMT and drug resistance in NSCLC; TGF-beta and TNF-alpha not named.

claim: Tumors remove natural killer group 2D ligands, which is one of the primary mechanisms responsible for subverting NKG2D-mediated immunosurveillance in leukemia stem cells.

evidence.quote: AML cells that express NKG2DLs are cleared by NK cells, whereas NKG2DL-negative leukaemic cells isolated from the same individual escape cell killing by NK cells.
evidence.note: NKG2DL-negative leukaemic stem-like cells escape NK killing; ligands absent on LSCs. Strict re-read: the quote does not state Tumors shedding/removing NKG2D ligands in leukemia stem cells not stated.

evidence.quote: This applies in particular to acute myeloid leukemia (AML), which evades immune detection by downregulation of NKG2D ligands (NKG2D-L), including MICA. The absence of NKG2D-L on AML cells is moreover associated with leukemia stem cell characteristics.
evidence.note: AML evades immune detection via NKG2D ligand downregulation; absence linked to leukemia stem cells. Strict re-read: the quote does not state Tumors 'remove' ligands as primary mechanism in LSCs; quote only AML downregulation of NKG2D-L.

claim: Using aldehyde dehydrogenase in combination with CD133 to analyze ovarian cancer cell lines, greater growth is observed in ALDH+/CD133+ cells than ALDH+/CD133− cells, suggesting further enrichment of ovarian CSCs in the double-positive population.

evidence.quote: ALDH+ , CD133+ and ALDH+ CD133+ cells from fresh tumors developed larger tumors more rapidly than their negative counterparts.
evidence.note: Double-positive cells formed larger tumors faster than negative cells; not compared with ALDH+/CD133- cells.

claim: A distinct gene signature associated with tumorigenic CD24−/low/CD44+ cell populations compared to normal breast epithelium correlates with shorter distant metastasis-free and overall survival, demonstrating that presence and frequency of this cell population has prognostic relevance.

evidence.quote: There was a significant association between the IGS and both overall and metastasis-free survival (P<0.001, for both) in patients with breast cancer, which was independent of established clinical and pathological variables.
evidence.note: Signature from CD44+CD24-/low cells significantly associated with both survival measures; direction not stated here, though 'poor prognosis' groups noted.

claim: Aldehyde dehydrogenase 1 plays a crucial role in maintaining CSC properties and promoting therapy resistance in various cancer types.

evidence.quote: Pertinently, our study integrated bioinformatics, in-vitro and in-vivo experiments to elucidate that E2F1 can induce ALDH1A1 through autophagy, thus promoting self-renewal and drug resistance of LCSCs, as well as tumorigenicity.
evidence.note: one instance: in lung cancer stem cells, ALDH1A1 promotes self-renewal and drug resistance. Strict re-read: the quote does not state ALDH1 role across various cancer types not stated; only E2F1/ALDH1A1 in LCSCs.

evidence.quote: Notably, inhibiting ALDH1A1 in these cells promotes F-actin polymerization and increases cellular stiffness, reducing their stemness while enhancing their susceptibility to natural killer (NK) cell-mediated cytotoxicity.
evidence.note: one instance: in AML leukemic stem cells, inhibiting ALDH1A1 reduces stemness; therapy resistance only implied. Strict re-read: the quote does not state ALDH1 crucial role in CSC maintenance and therapy resistance across cancers not stated.

claim: ALDH1 expression is associated with tumor progression and therapy resistance in melanoma, glioma, prostate cancer, and pancreatic cancer.

evidence.quote: we demonstrated that ALDH1A1 and ALDH1A3 maintain the CSC phenotype and radioresistance and regulate bone metastasis-initiating cells.
evidence.note: one instance: prostate cancer only; ALDH1A1/ALDH1A3 tied to progression and radioresistance, with opposite expression-outcome correlations.

evidence.quote: BRAF and MEK inhibitor therapy increases ALDH1 expression in patient melanomas, and effectively combines with nifuroxazide in melanoma cell models.
evidence.note: one instance: melanoma; therapy raises ALDH1 expression, but progression association not stated here.

claim: CRISPR-based functional screens enable systematic interrogation of genes required for CSC maintenance and therapeutic resistance, accelerating identification of actionable targets.

evidence.quote: Using CRISPR-Cas9 approaches in patient-derived GBM stem cells (GSCs) to interrogate function of the coding genome, we identify actionable pathways responsible for growth, which reveal the gene-essential circuitry of GBM stemness and proliferation.
evidence.note: CRISPR-Cas9 screens in glioblastoma stem cells identify actionable growth and stemness pathways; resistance stated in later sentence. Strict re-read: the quote does not state Systematic screens, CSC maintenance, therapeutic resistance generally not stated; only GBM stem cells.

evidence.quote: In this primer, we discuss the progress made and emerging opportunities of coupling advanced CRISPR screening systems with CSC models to reveal the understudied vulnerabilities of CSCs.
evidence.note: CRISPR screening coupled with CSC models used to reveal CSC vulnerabilities and genetic determinants. Strict re-read: the quote does not state CRISPR screens identifying genes required for CSC maintenance/resistance; quote only discusses prospects.

claim: Organoids are used as in vitro models to understand tumor heterogeneity and variability of patient response to cancer treatments.

evidence.quote: Organotypic models of patient-specific tumours are revolutionizing our understanding of cancer heterogeneity and its implications for personalized medicine.
evidence.note: Patient-derived organoid models advance understanding of cancer heterogeneity and personalized medicine. Strict re-read: the quote does not state Organoids not named; patient response variability to treatment not stated.

evidence.quote: Moreover, the drug-response results in PDOs are validated in patient-derived organoids-based xenograft (PDOX) mice and are consistent with the actual clinical response in 91.7% (11/12) of patients with GC.
evidence.note: Gastric cancer patient-derived organoids' drug responses matched clinical response in 11 of 12 patients. Strict re-read: the quote does not state Organoids modeling tumor heterogeneity and variability of response; quote only 91.7% concordance in gastric cancer.

claim: OV6+ HCC cells with endogenously active Wnt/β-catenin signaling are resistant to standard chemotherapy, indicating that assessment of this marker can guide treatment selection.

evidence.quote: These OV6(+) HCC cells possess a greater ability to form tumor in vivo and show a substantial resistance to standard chemotherapy compared with OV6(-) tumor cells.
evidence.note: OV6+ HCC cells with endogenous Wnt/beta-catenin activity show substantial resistance to standard chemotherapy. Strict re-read: the quote does not state Treatment selection guided by marker not stated.

claim: Small numbers of CSCs can reconstruct entire cancer tissue, leading to recurrence after surgery.

evidence.quote: F3-antibody-sorted glioblastoma cells exhibit stem cell gene expression, enhance self-renewal in culture, drive tumor initiation and serial transplantation, and reconstitute tumor heterogeneity.
evidence.note: Sorted glioblastoma stem-like cells reconstitute tumors in mice; no cell number or post-surgery recurrence stated.

evidence.quote: A key driver of this recurrence is the presence of cancer stem cells (CSCs), which exhibit resistance to chemotherapy and possess the capacity for self-renewal, plasticity, and tumor regeneration.
evidence.note: Cancer stem cells drive ovarian cancer recurrence and regenerate tumors; no small-number or surgery link stated.

claim: Boolean logic circuits implemented in CAR-T cells enable AND-gate activation requiring multiple antigens or NOT-gate inhibition by normal tissue markers, reducing on-target off-tumor toxicity.

evidence.quote: We exploited the cooperative role of LAT and SLP-76 to engineer logic-gated intracellular network (LINK) CAR, a rapid and reversible Boolean-logic AND-gated CAR T cell platform that outperforms other systems in both efficacy and prevention of on-target, off-tumour toxicity.
evidence.note: AND-gated LINK CAR outperforms others in preventing on-target off-tumour toxicity; AND-gate only, no NOT-gate. Strict re-read: the quote does not state NOT-gate inhibition and multi-antigen AND-gate mechanism broadly; only LINK CAR AND-gate.

evidence.quote: Additionally, we demonstrate the utility of this model in testing strategies to mitigate on-target toxicity, such as Boolean-logic AND-gate approaches.
evidence.note: Tests Boolean-logic AND-gate strategies to mitigate on-target toxicity; model use, no outcome stated.
